notes: Form 1040 Line 3b: total ordinary dividends. Composes from box 1a over the closed tax.us.2025.f1099div.1a family only (ADR-0035 decisions 1-2, per-box closure independence): closed-empty publishes an honest zero, undeclared or open blocks this line independently of line 3a's box-1b family. Core v66 (itemization-cents, Track 2): the box-1a subtotal now carries cents, so this line rounds it once with the rounding convention. A whole-dollar subtotal gives the same value as before.
